subject: NovaHealth renewal — procurement gate, consumption thresholds, and onboarding refresh
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia.park@novahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Steele <msteele@novahealth.com>, procurement@novahealth.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 08:23:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal planning — seats + consumption thresholds / procurement portal question

Hi Hannah,

Our renewal for CH-4592 is coming up and we expect to increase consumption by ~40% next year (additional inference capacity for experimental pipelines). Procurement asked me to confirm a few items before we kick off the PO:

- Do you support onboarding via our procurement portal (we prefer to upload contracts/attachments on our side)?
- What evidence/files do you need to validate vendor onboarding vs. the standard renewal?
- Any recommended term changes if we commit to a larger capacity (e.g., discounts at 18/24 months)?

I've attached the current contract (current_contract.pdf) and a one-page usage snapshot (novahealth-usage-report.xlsx). Our procurement timeline is: internal approvals by Oct 15, PO submission by Oct 18.

Can you confirm what you need from us and any blackout windows for migration if we bump capacity?

Thanks,
Julia Park
Senior Program Manager, Data Science
NovaHealth

Attachment: current_contract.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: novahealth-usage-report.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@novahealth.com>, Marcus Steele <msteele@novahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — seats + consumption thresholds / procurement portal question

Hi Julia — great to hear from you and thanks for the attachments. High level next steps from our side so procurement has everything to move the PO through: 

1) Procurement portal: we can accept uploads or we can push a pre-filled MSA/SOW via DocuSign. If you want to upload to your portal, send the sharing link and we will drop the signed MSA + SOW there.

2) Evidence needed for vendor onboarding (for NovaHealth's procurement team):
   - Signed MSA + updated SOW with capacity line-items
   - Updated W-9 (we'll attach) and PO billing contact
   - SOC 2 attestation (we have the report; will link)
   - Usage report + projected consumption (you already shared — thank you)

3) Term / pricing: for a ~40% capacity increase we typically model two options: 12-month with a one-time capacity addendum (no commit discount), or 24-month with stepped discounts (5% at 12mo, 10% at 24mo) and a lower overage rate. If you can share preferred term, we can produce both sample SOWs.

4) Blackout / migration windows: no service interruption expected; we recommend a non-peak migration window. If you plan to change quantization/latency profiles, coordinate with our ops team (we can book a 60-minute technical sync).

I'll attach an initial renewal MPA draft for legal redline and a link to the SOC 2. If that looks good, our recommended cadence is:
- Oct 6: Redwood sends redline-ready MPA/SOW
- Oct 12: Legal alignment
- Oct 18: NovaHealth submits PO

Let us know if those dates fit your internal timeline.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
---
Attachment: renewal-mpa-draft.docx (docx)
Related link: https://drive.redwood.com/s/renewal-novahealth-CH-4592
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Julia Park <julia.park@novahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal planning — seats + consumption thresholds / procurement portal question

Thanks Hannah. A couple internal asks so procurement doesn't hit a gate: 

- Finance wants a pre-authorized credit note path for the first month of overage if NovaHealth spikes beyond projected consumption during ramp. Suggest we include a one-month buffer credit (finger-in-the-air $) in the SOW so procurement can route faster.

- Legal: please route the renewal-mpa-draft to legal for redline ASAP and request standard exceptions for invoice terms. I can spin up the renewal SOW with both 12- and 24-month pricing lines (we'll include stepped discounts).

- Ops: confirm that capacity increases are hot-add and don't require scheduled downtime. If there is any machine-type swap (e.g., a move to A100->H100), we need to flag a technical window.

I'll prepare the SOW draft and will include a line for the pre-authorized credit (will annotate). Hannah — please confirm if NovaHealth requires net-30 or net-45 and we'll reflect.

-Marissa
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Renewal planning — seats + consumption thresholds / procurement portal question

Hannah / Marissa — thanks for the quick turn. Procurement confirms the Oct 18 PO target and prefers:

- Net-30 invoice terms (we cannot take net-45)
- Please include the pre-authorized one-month buffer credit in the SOW wording so our approvers see it in the document
- We will upload documents to our portal (https://procure.novahealth.com/tickets/7531). Please drop the signed MSA + SOW there when ready.

Also, can you send a DocuSign link for the MSA once it's redline-clean? That speeds routing internally. If possible, include an appendix outlining stepped discounts by capacity band (0-25%, 25-50%, 50%+).

If all aligns, I'll expect the SOW + DocuSign by Oct 6 so we can get legal sign-off by Oct 12.

Julia Park
Senior Program Manager, Data Science
NovaHealth
